preserves Swift
boundaries, explicit and empty logical lines, styles, and continuation indents. Its

policy prefers whitespace and hard-wraps unbroken tokens. It is not a complete Unicode line-breaking algorithm. At width zero, each logical input line becomes one empty output line. An over-wide continuation indent is truncated to reserve one content cell. A single
wider than that cell remains atomic, and
draws it only when its complete cell width fits.
